systems.platform: ThinkMD phone-based clinical assessment and triage tool
systems.owner: Southwest State Ministry of Health (ThinkMD provides platform)

SOM.note: ThinkMD is a clinical triage tool at 22 facilities, not stated to be routine aggregate reporting or a transportable patient record; DHIS2 feed is only planned.
The page says platform data are designed to feed the national system through DHIS2, a plan; it states no national health information system in service or under way.
